 Rockets and Kevin Durant head to Phoenix for a reunion
 We’ll be seeing some old friends tonight. So will Kevin Durant, Jalen Green and Dillon Brooks
 by Darren Yuvan Nov 8, 2026, 12:00 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Houston Rockets vs. Phoenix Suns
 November 7, 2026
 Location: Mortgage Matchup Center - Phoenix, Arizona
 Time: 8:00 PM CST
 TV: Space City Home Network
 Radio :KBME Sports Talk 790 / KLTN 102.9 (en español)
 Probable starting lineups
 Rockets: Fred VanVleet, Amen Thompson, Jabari Smith Jr., Kevin Durant, Alperen Sengun
 Suns: Devin Booker, Jalen Green, Dillon Brooks, Miles Bridges, Oso Ighodaro
 Kevin Durant, Jalen Green and Dillon Brooks in a reunion tonight! Tune in tonight and come chat with us at TDS on on the SB Nation App!
